# bdk hooks - what runs on Claude Code events

::: v-pre

Claude Code runs these hooks while the plugin is enabled.

## PreToolUse on Bash {#pre-tool-use-bash}

Event: `PreToolUse` · Matcher: `Bash` · Timeout: 10 s

PreToolUse hook: deny git history changes of subagents when hooks.subagent-git is on.

Runs: `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bdk.mjs" hooks pre-tool-use - || exit 1`

## SessionStart {#session-start}

Event: `SessionStart` · Timeout: 10 s

SessionStart hook: a short BDK context, or one warning without a configuration.

Runs: `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bdk.mjs" hooks session-start - || exit 2`

:::
